13: 	"github.com/kong/kubernetes-ingress-controller/v2/internal/annotations"

16: 	kongv1 "github.com/kong/kubernetes-ingress-controller/v2/pkg/apis/configuration/v1"

20: // updateReferredObjects updates reference records where the referrer is the object in parameter obj.
21: // currently it only updates reference records to secrets, since we wanted to limit cache size of secrets:
22: // https://github.com/Kong/kubernetes-ingress-controller/issues/2868
23: func updateReferredObjects(
24: 	ctx context.Context, client client.Client, refIndexers ctrlref.CacheIndexers, dataplaneClient *dataplane.KongClient, obj client.Object) error {
25: 
26: 	referredSecretNames := make(map[types.NamespacedName]struct{})
27: 	for _, nsName := range listReferredObjects(obj) {
28: 		referredSecretNames[nsName] = struct{}{}
29: 	}
30: 
31: 	return ctrlref.UpdateReferencesToSecret(ctx, client, refIndexers, dataplaneClient, obj, referredSecretNames)
32: }
33: 
34: func listReferredObjects(obj client.Object) []types.NamespacedName {
35: 	switch obj := obj.(type) {
36: 	case *corev1.Service:
37: 		return listCoreV1ServiceReferredSecrets(obj)
38: 	case *netv1.Ingress:
39: 		return listNetV1IngressReferredSecrets(obj)
40: 	case *netv1beta1.Ingress:
41: 		return listNetV1beta1IngressReferredSecrets(obj)
42: 	case *extv1beta1.Ingress:
43: 		return listExtensionV1beta1IngressReferredSecrets(obj)
44: 	case *kongv1.KongPlugin:
45: 		return listKongPluginReferredSecrets(obj)
46: 	case *kongv1.KongClusterPlugin:
47: 		return listKongClusterPluginReferredSecrets(obj)
48: 	case *kongv1.KongConsumer:
49: 		return listKongConsumerReferredSecrets(obj)
50: 	case *kongv1beta1.TCPIngress:
51: 		return listTCPIngressReferredSecrets(obj)
52: 	}
53: 	return nil
